title: Anker Vs. Ugreen: Which Mobile Accessory Brand Is Best For You? - BGR
summary: Anker and Ugreen are two leading sellers of mobile charging accessories including wireless chargers, USB hubs and docks, and cables. While Ugreen sells its Uno charger at 65W, Anker makes a tinier touchscreen charger at 45W.
